plan.title: rfc(swarm,cursor): envelope when Task cannot prove a local worktree dest

narratives.Description: Cursor cannot start an isolated implement worker through Task. Extra dest keys never reach the hook, and rewriting dest fields does not move the child. Next-build is dest-placing Cursor that is not Task-dest: nursery inherit on a dest-rooted window, plus dest-rooted SDK Agent.create. The GitHub body three-envelope list is history, not the spec. Recut: next-build contract is not this body. Successor lean 5620250875.
narratives.Overview: Recut: GitHub issue body three-envelope list is history. Next-build is successor lean https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4295#issuecomment-5620250875. Bound remedy is the five plan items: nursery inherit dest, dest-rooted Agent.create, fence-in-place parked, Task has no local dest field (5611146439), dest-placing Cursor not dest-binding Task. Shipped in https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/4322 merge 70a044052079dbcf0c68158adec2212aedc36a07.
narratives.Labels: documentation, swarm, rfc, agent-experience, process, harness, design-critique:ingest-ready
narratives.UserStory: As a Cursor parent, I want local implement children to start already rooted on a reserved linked worktree without Task dest fields, so that through-merge dispatch is not denied and the parent does not implement on the primary checkout.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add a nursery inherit consult in the spawn-occupancy source file: when the Cursor window payload root is a non-primary linked worktree, mint a reservation and occupancy:grant, and deny parent product writes while the grant is live. 2. Document dest-rooted @cursor/sdk Agent.create with cwd set to the reserved worktree, reservation before exec, process-handle liveness, and a doctor check; recut host-cursor.md so local implement does not dispatch via Task. Add tests that Task dest keys stay unadvertised and fence-in-place stays parked.

items.title: When the Cursor window payload root is a non-primary linked worktree of this repo, unoccupied except by this parent, treat that payload root as dest, mint a unique reservation, and admit the child through occupancy:grant. While that grant is live, deny parent product writes in that tree.
